answer_1.quote: We introduce the task of sentence level cloze completion with multiple sentence blanks and a shared candidate set with distractors.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for sentence-level cloze questions

answer_2.quote: We design two metrics to evaluate models. Both of these metrics are reported as percentage.

answer_4.quote: We hire annotators from AMT to both answer and label difficulty for 144 randomly chosen test examples.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are restricted to be from USA/UK and have Master designation on AMT, along with > 90% HIT approval rate.
